title: About the application
description: An application for managing budgets and expenses by category — designed as a portfolio project and an example of a microservices-based solution.

register.primary: 1. Register an account and sign in
register.secondary: After signing in, the app will remember your session and show the main dashboard.

categories.secondary: Categories are e.g. Food, Transport, Entertainment — they help you group expenses and budgets.

budgets.secondary: For each category you can set weekly, monthly, and yearly budgets.

expenses.secondary: You assign expenses to a category with a date and amount. The app compares them with the budget.

dashboard.secondary: On the main panel you will see summaries, charts, and whether you are within budget.

settings.secondary: You can change account details, reset data, or delete the account.

technical.title: 2) Technical description (technical)
technical.intro: The solution is based on a distributed architecture: the frontend communicates with a BFF (Backend For Frontend) layer, and the BFF orchestrates calls to independent microservices.

frontend.secondary: SPA application: views, forms, charts, validation, HTTP communication.

bff.secondary: Single entry point from the frontend, JWT auth, data aggregation, OpenFeign calls to services.

userService.secondary: User account operations (e.g. registration, sign-in, profile data).

budgetService.secondary: Categories and budgets (e.g. weekly/monthly/yearly), budget reset logic.

expenseService.secondary: Expenses and bulk operations (e.g. data reset), preparing data for the dashboard.

databases.secondary: Separate databases per service; part of the environment assumes replication of the expense DB instance.

technical.security: Security: frontend→BFF communication uses a JWT token (Bearer), and the BFF passes user context to microservices.

generator.secondary: Generating the API client for the frontend
